name: postlane
description: Send transactional email with the Postlane API. Use for welcome mail, password resets, receipts, and notifications.

interface.longDescription: Adds Postlane transactional email to your app: welcome mail, email verification, password resets, receipts, and notifications. The skill teaches the agent the Postlane HTTP API (POST /v1/emails with an Idempotency-Key), saved templates, error handling, and the DNS records needed to verify a sending domain. It is for developers who want their app to send email from their own domain. It does not create a mailbox, send attachments, or provide a signed webhook stream, and sending requires a Postlane account with a verified domain and a pl_live_ API key.
capabilities: Add transactional email to an app
defaultPrompt: Send a welcome email when a user signs up, using Postlane.
Add a password reset email with the Reset your password template.
What DNS records do I need to verify my sending domain?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: a skill for sending transactional email with the Postlane API.
